# File `msg.hpp`

Portable, versioned IPC message serialization.

Version zero starts with ASCII `PUCI`, a version byte, optional-section flags, a network-order 16-bit header size, network-order channel and message identifiers, and a network-order 64-bit payload length. Optional session, timestamp, multipart, and opaque extension fields precede the payload. An optional SHA-256 checksum follows it. No native C++ layout enters the wire.
